text:
maria: Hey — customer hit a big latency spike and sent a stack trace. I have request_id=abc123def. What's the fastest path to raw request lines? Console search keeps collapsing fields.

jon: Console quickpath: Logs > Search and paste `x-request-id:abc123def` with a small time window. If the UI collapses fields click 'Show raw' or use the download arrow.

kevin: If you like CLI: `redwood logs fetch --request-id abc123def --format raw --start "2024-03-12T09:50:00Z" --end "2024-03-12T10:10:00Z"` — returns pod/edge lines and request headers.

maria: I don't have redwood CLI installed on my laptop, only kubectl. Any pod-level fallback?

jon: Fallback flow: find the trace first -> go to Traces in console -> search trace id from the stacktrace -> click spans to get span / edge headers -> then grep pod logs for that span or x-request-id.

ashley: Stern snippet that I use a lot:
```
stern -n prod '.*-service' --since 15m | rg "abc123def"
```
That catches container stdout across replicas.

priya: Edge proxy also logs x-request-ref/req-id. Quick kubectl: `kubectl -n edge logs deploy/proxy -c proxy --since=30m | rg abc123def`

ops-bot: tip: if you only have a span id use `redwood trace lookup --span SPANID` or console's "copy trace headers" then grep logs for that header.

kevin: One gotcha — sometimes console sampling means trace->logs link is missing. If that happens, widen time window by +/-2m and check ingress logs (they're less sampled).

maria: Is there a dashboard that can show recent requests grouped by x-request-ref? Could speed this up.

jon: Yep — per-route latency dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/req-latency?group=x-request-ref . Add `&q=abc123` or filter UI to the prefix. Add `?time=relative:15m` to lock the window.

priya: Also check the Canary rollouts panel (Console > Deploys) — a noisy canary at the same time will explain spikes.

maria: Thanks, starting with stern on edge and then tracing. Will post results.

devbot: deploy-bot: New prod deploy at 2024-03-12T09:55:12Z (canary 10%).

maria: Ah that lines up — will correlate timestamps and check the canary shard.

kevin: Quick checklist for others: 1) trace -> copy span header 2) grep ingress for header/x-request-id 3) stern pods in app namespace 4) if missing, use redwood logs fetch with request-id.

maria: Awesome, thanks everyone :pray: will follow up with log snippets when I have them.
